title: TravelRuleMessage
description: Reference subset of an IVMS101-style travel-rule message for anchor-to-anchor transfers. Institution-level fields only in this version — no end-user PII. See the api repo's docs/IVMS101_MAPPING.md for what's implemented vs. a full spec.

paymentReference.description: Pointer to the on-chain payment this message accompanies (e.g. a Stellar transaction hash).

amount.description: Transfer amount, as a string to avoid floating-point precision issues.

asset.description: Asset code, e.g. USDC, EURC, MGUSD.

name.description: Legal name of the originating/beneficiary institution (anchor), not an end user.

lei.description: Legal Entity Identifier, if available. Reference version does not validate against the real LEI registry.
